name: outline
desc_en: The photograph arrives whole except for the mountain, whose shape stays bare paper for a moment, then Aoraki fills its own outline in one beat.
desc_zh: 照片整張到齊，只有山是一塊空白的紙；停一下，庫克山在一拍之內填進自己的輪廓。
borrowed: A photograph that is whole except for one shape, so the eye goes straight to the hole and reads two depths at once; here the hole is the mountain, held as bare paper until it fills.
